scope: Public website presentation and targeted UI checks; no source-project runtime or acceptance change.

methodUses.adaptation: Existing GitHub Pages repository; preserve the same hosting, anchors, project boundaries and dated evidence. No new Site.

changes: Replace 84 northeast arrow characters with decorative inline SVGs on the English/Czech home and project pages. The reviewed browser displayed missing-glyph boxes before the change.
Increase shared header navigation and language link target height to at least 44 CSS px, with wrapping and an adjusted anchor offset on narrow screens.
Make the existing main skip target focusable without adding a sequential tab stop on all six pages using portfolio.css.
Underline and colour inline links in project descriptions; version the changed shared stylesheet URL.

checks.preservation: Compared all six changed HTML pages with baseCommit: all IDs, anchor attributes and inline script bodies are unchanged.

browser.environment: Chrome; managed preview of the selected GitHub source. Frame widths are CSS layout checks, not physical-device acceptance.

skipLink.after: main receives focus; the next Tab reaches Read the case studies

paths: English home → Engineering case-studies section → Windows-path case study
Case-studies section → forged-report case study, verified by keyboard activation
Czech mobile navigation → Contact, heading visible below the sticky header
Czech mobile project notes → HoubarSky section on projekty.html
Case-study header → English home → Czech home
browser.icons: 19 SVG arrows visible on each home page; after screenshot confirms the arrow shape.

limits: Targeted UI review, not a complete accessibility audit or a physical Android/iOS test.
External destinations were not all rechecked, and no e-mail was sent.
No model calls, technical candidate campaigns, source-project runtime changes or new project-acceptance claims.
The local QA receipt does not prove deployment; use the existing GitHub Pages deployment run for that result.
